It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} The district encompasses the province's northern half composed of its capital city [[Calapan]] and the municipalities of [[Baco, Oriental Mindoro|Baco]], [[Naujan]], [[Pola, Oriental Mindoro|Pola]], [[Puerto Galera]], [[San Teodoro, Oriental Mindoro|San Teodoro]], [[Socorro, Oriental Mindoro|Socorro]] and [[Victoria, Oriental Mindoro|Victoria]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Arnan Panaligan|Arnan C.
